onlineskins.settings.enable_preview: Show your character in a corner while you play

onlineskins.settings.enable_preview_cust: Allow moving and resizing the previews
Drag a preview with the left mouse button to move it, and use the mouse wheel to resize it.
onlineskins.settings.disable_transparenc: Show transparent parts of skins as opaque
Useful if you see holes in badly made skins.
onlineskins.settings.show_title_preview: Show your character on the title screen
Your character and its buttons beside the title screen menu.
onlineskins.settings.show_pause_preview: Show your character in the pause menu
Your character and its buttons beside the pause menu.
onlineskins.settings.compact_change_skin: Compact the Change Skin button to make it smaller
Show the Change Skin button on the title screen and pause menu as a small icon.
The cape menu only shows the capes you imported.

onlineskins.settings.disable_transparenc: Turn off OnlineSkins's transparency system for every player
Every skin on this server is shown without transparency. Useful if someone uses invisible or see-through skins to troll.
onlineskins.settings.allow_hd_skins_serv: Lets players use skins wider than 64x64. Unticked, other players see standard skins only, and a wider skin stays on its owner's screen. A limit of another size is set with maxSkinResolution in onlineskins-server.json.
